name: Modular Hull Socket Item
desc: Something that can be installed in a Modular Hull Socket on a ship's skill tree.

name: Hull Upgrade Item
desc: Unique hull upgrade that grants one Hull Framework point to a ship of one hull size.

name: Nanite Feedstock
desc: Components recovered by disassembling hull items you no longer need.

name: Augmentation Nanoswarm
desc: Adds one more rolled effect to a domain subroutine, up to four. A common subroutine that gains its third effect becomes rare.

name: Tuning Nanoswarm
desc: Rerolls the values of every effect on a hull item within its usual range.

name: Metamorph Nanoswarm
desc: Rewrites a unique hull item into a different unique hull item.

name: Fundamental Nanoswarm
desc: Rerolls the values of a hull item's implicit effects within their usual range.

name: Reshaping Nanoswarm
desc: Removes a random effect from a hull item and rolls a new one in its place. Fixed effects are never removed.

name: Immutable Nanoswarm
desc: Fixes one random effect on a hull item with at least two effects. A fixed effect can't be removed or rerolled, and each hull item can only have one.

name: Replicator Nanoseed
desc: Makes a mirrored copy of a hull item. Mirrored items can't be modified or copied again. Replication Kernels can't be synthesised.

name: Corrupted Nanoswarm
desc: Corrupts an item, modifying it unpredictably.

name: Prefix Inhibitor
desc: Turned on at the Hull Item or Star Chart Modification workbench. The next Tuning, Reshaping or Immutable Nanoswarm, Reforging Cipher or Annulment Cipher leaves every existing prefix alone. Wards can only be found.

name: Suffix Inhibitor
desc: Turned on at the Hull Item or Star Chart Modification workbench. The next Tuning, Reshaping or Immutable Nanoswarm, Reforging Cipher or Annulment Cipher leaves every existing suffix alone. Wards can only be found.

name: Star Chart
desc: Coordinates to a star system cut off from hyperspace. Opening a wormhole with it uses it up.

name: Reforging Cipher
desc: Rerolls every modifier on a Star Chart at its tier, with its rarity following the new modifier count. Only found inside Star Chart systems.

name: Annulment Cipher
desc: Removes every modifier from a Star Chart, or only the unprotected side while an inhibitor is on. Only found inside Star Chart systems.

name: Cartographer's Cipher
desc: Raises a Star Chart's tier by one, up to tier 15. Only found inside Star Chart systems.
